Eli Crane for a Live Telephone Town Hall From Washington, D.C. Tonight, Rep. Eli Crane (R-AZ) will hold a live telephone town hall from Washington, D.C., at 5:00 p.m. MST (Arizona Time). Constituents will have the opportunity to ask questions, vote in polls, and receive an update from Rep. Crane on the latest… Continue Reading (TONIGHT – Join Rep. Eli Crane for a Live Telephone Town Hall From Washington, D.C.) August 28 2026 Rep. Crane Touts Rural Healthcare Win, Hosts Secretary Burgum Recently, Rep. Eli Crane (R-AZ) attended several engagements to advocate on behalf of rural Arizonans. With the annual district work period drawing to a close, he used the time to strengthen partnerships, host Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum, and meet with stakeholders… Continue Reading (Rep. Crane Touts Rural Healthcare Win, Hosts Secretary Burgum) August 21 2026 SBA Offers Relief to Small Businesses and Nonprofits Impacted by the Pocket Fire Last week, the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) announced the availability of low-interest federal disaster loans for small businesses and private nonprofit organizations experiencing economic losses from the Pocket Fire. The disaster declaration, issued on August 11, covers Coconino, Gila, La Paz, Maricopa, Mohave,… Continue Reading (SBA Offers Relief to Small Businesses and Nonprofits Impacted by the Pocket Fire) August 05 2026 Rep. Crane Listens to and Advocates for Rural Arizonans Last week, Rep. Eli Crane (R-AZ) traveled across rural Arizona to meet with constituents, key stakeholders, and industry leaders.
